Factor exposures: market 0.55 (t 15.4), size -0.20 (t -3.7), growth 0.28 (t 2.4), momentum 0.02 (t 0.4); together they explain 85% of the daily variation (R²).

Verdict: most of the return is factor exposure (+17.4% a year, market above all); the alpha left is not significant.
